description: Scania CV AB supplies this truck-operation dataset hosted by the UCI Machine Learning Repository. It covers failures of the air-pressure system used for functions including braking and gear changes. The training set contains 60000 examples, including 1000 positive APS-failure cases, and the test set contains 16000 examples. The source lists 171 anonymized attributes combining numeric counters and histogram bins; missing values use na. Positive and negative classes distinguish APS failures from failures in other components. Coverage is heavy Scania trucks in everyday use; operating locations and acquisition dates are not stated. The dataset supports condition monitoring and fault-classification models with asymmetric missed-fault and unnecessary-inspection penalties. CSV distributions are listed. Licence statements conflict: the embedded contributor text specifies GPL version 3 or later, while the current UCI portal displays CC BY 4.0. Applicable terms remain unresolved; reuse charges are not stated. A limitation is that anonymization conceals physical variable meanings. Competition scores were excluded from the retained projection; no data files were fetched.
